svg.title: NeuralGraph: persistent memory for AI agents
svg.desc: Three conversation turns flow through asynchronous extraction, grounding and reconciliation into a persistent graph: three memories about the speaker Ali, and typed relations from Ali to the entities Berlin (lives_in, superseded), Kreuzberg (lives_in, current), Charité (works_at) and Luna (has_pet).
